newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Planters sets 275 to 300 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Planters sets 275 to 300 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Philippines' Planters Development Bank said on Thursday its board had approved a resolution giving 275 percent to 300 percent stock dividend to its preferred shareholders as of February 15 this year.

"The Board approves the declaration of a 275 percent stock dividend .. should the unimpaired/unrestricted surplus of the corporation as of February 15, 1997 allow it, a 300 percent stock dividend is approved and declared," corporate secretary Santos Senga said.
The bank has four classes of preferred shares. Only the 2.048 million preferred C shares are listed in the exchange.
